description: This file defines the TaskEditDialog object in an Android application, responsible for presenting a dialog to create or edit tasks with fields like title, description, category, and due date. It includes methods for showing the dialog, handling user input, and invoking callbacks for save, delete actions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a dialog for creating or editing a task, pre-filled with initial data if provided. Handles user interactions for setting task details such as title, description, category, and due date. Calls onSave when the task is saved and onDelete if deletion is requested.
